verdict.rationale: Gram exposes a 'Platform MCP' server that lets an agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) 'find and add MCP servers... without opening the dashboard' and separately supports discovering/importing third-party servers 'powered by the official MCP Registry,' which is a documented, protocol-based interface for programmatic discovery. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose REST/OpenAPI catalog endpoint (the openapi.json probe returned 404s), so discovery is MCP-protocol-only rather than a broader documented API surface. Missing for 10: a standalone REST/OpenAPI catalog API, independent/hands-on corroboration of agent-driven discovery working in practice.
